_comment: This mirrors the connections already embedded per-asset. Keeping a flat list too makes it trivial to render a full dependency-graph overlay without walking every asset file. Keep both in sync when editing by hand, or generate this file from the assets at build time.

connections.description: Target cueing from paired reconnaissance drone.

_note_unresolved_ids: Several target_ids above (e.g. side_a-uav-reconnaissance-tactical, side_a-logistics-hub-op-deep, side_a-c2-integrated-air-defense-network, side_b-uav-reconnaissance-tactical, side_b-logistics-hub-op-near, *-medical-casevac-chain) are placeholders for assets not yet built in this scaffold. This is intentional — it demonstrates that connections can reference not-yet-created assets; the UI loader should render these as 'pending' stub nodes or simply hide the line until the target exists, rather than erroring.
